fact: The TMA Agrometeorological Database, commissioned by TMA, FAO, USDA and Washington State University, automatically downloads satellite rainfall (CHIRPS), NDVI and soil moisture data and maps them by dekad with experimental drought hazard maps from 2001 to the present, publicly viewable at agromet.meteo.go.tz; manual examples run to March 2020.
title: Tanzania Meteorological Authority (TMA) Agrometeorological Database
